entries.title: The synthetic record
entries.content: The amber queue retries three times.

entries.title: The synthetic record
entries.content: The amber queue makes at most three retries.

rationale: Both state the same retry ceiling.

entries.title: Birch synthetic record

entries.content: Protocol 2 is required by Birch release 4.

rationale: The version and requirement are identical.

entries.title: Cobalt synthetic record
entries.content: Cobalt never caches failed responses.

entries.content: Failed responses are not cached by Cobalt.

rationale: Negation is preserved.

entries.title: Dune synthetic record

rationale: The same synthetic endpoint is restated.

entries.title: Elm synthetic record
entries.content: Elm stores durations in milliseconds.

entries.title: Elm synthetic record

rationale: The unit abbreviation changes no meaning.

entries.title: Fable synthetic record
entries.content: Fable workers stop after 40 tasks.

entries.content: A Fable worker task limit is forty.

rationale: The numerical limits are equivalent.

entries.title: Glint synthetic record
entries.content: Glint orders equal scores by ascending key.

rationale: The same tie breaker is described.

entries.title: Harbor synthetic record

entries.title: Iris synthetic record

entries.title: Iris synthetic record

rationale: Environment and policy match.

entries.title: Juniper synthetic record
entries.content: Juniper signs the header, not the body.

entries.title: Juniper synthetic record
entries.content: Only the header is signed in Juniper; the body is unsigned.

rationale: Both preserve the signed and unsigned portions.

entries.title: Kite synthetic record
entries.content: Kite keeps one spare worker.

entries.title: Kite synthetic record
entries.content: Kite maintains a single standby worker.

rationale: Spare and standby describe the same capacity.

entries.title: Lumen synthetic record
entries.content: Lumen calls a successful dry run a rehearsal.

entries.title: Lumen synthetic record
entries.content: In Lumen, rehearsal means a successful dry run.

rationale: The apparently informal term is explicitly defined.

entries.title: Mica synthetic record
entries.content: Mica requires a lease before cleanup.

entries.title: Mica synthetic record

rationale: The same ordering constraint is restated.

entries.title: Nimbus synthetic record
entries.content: Nimbus v2 has no legacy decoder.

entries.content: There is no legacy decoder in Nimbus version 2.

rationale: The same versioned absence is stated.

entries.title: Opal synthetic record
entries.content: Opal considers an empty batch successful.

entries.title: Opal synthetic record
entries.content: An Opal batch with zero items succeeds.

rationale: Both define the same boundary behavior.

entries.title: Amber synthetic record
entries.content: Amber policy revision 1: timeout is 20 seconds.

entries.content: Amber policy revision 2 replaces revision 1: timeout is 35 seconds.

rationale: The explicit newer revision replaces the old limit.

entries.title: Birch synthetic record
entries.content: Effective release 6, Birch replaces protocol 1 with protocol 3.

entries.title: Birch synthetic record

rationale: The stated effective release directs replacement.

entries.title: Cobalt synthetic record

entries.title: Cobalt synthetic record

rationale: Explicit policy replacement reverses the permission.

entries.title: Dune synthetic record

rationale: The newer endpoint is explicitly authoritative.

entries.title: Elm synthetic record
entries.content: Elm retention policy 2 keeps logs for 14 days.

entries.title: Elm synthetic record
entries.content: Elm retention policy 3 replaces policy 2 and keeps logs for 7 days.

rationale: A newer named policy reduces retention.

entries.title: Fable synthetic record
entries.content: Fable setting revision 6 replaces revision 5 and disables compression.

entries.title: Fable synthetic record
entries.content: Fable setting revision 5 enables compression.

rationale: A newer revision negates the older setting.

entries.title: Glint synthetic record
entries.content: Glint chooses descending keys under policy A.

entries.title: Glint synthetic record
entries.content: Glint policy B supersedes A and chooses ascending keys.

rationale: Explicit supersession determines direction.

entries.title: Harbor synthetic record
entries.content: Harbor bulletin 2 replaces bulletin 1 and limits workers to 12.

rationale: The later bulletin changes the same limit.

entries.title: Iris synthetic record
entries.content: Iris flag policy 1 makes tracing mandatory.

entries.title: Iris synthetic record
entries.content: Iris flag policy 2 replaces policy 1: tracing is optional.

rationale: Mandatory and optional conflict under an explicit replacement.

entries.title: Juniper synthetic record
entries.content: Juniper contract 4 replaces contract 3 and signs headers and bodies.

rationale: The newer contract expands the signed surface.

entries.title: Kite synthetic record
entries.content: Kite deployment rule 1 requires two approvals.

entries.title: Kite synthetic record
entries.content: Kite deployment rule 2 replaces rule 1 and requires one approval.

rationale: The approval count is explicitly revised.

entries.content: Lumen glossary 2 replaces glossary 1: ready means validated.

rationale: The newer glossary resolves ambiguous wording.

entries.content: Mica policy 1 allows cleanup without a lease.

entries.title: Mica synthetic record
entries.content: Mica policy 2 replaces policy 1: cleanup requires a lease.

rationale: The newer requirement reverses an allowance.

entries.title: Nimbus synthetic record
entries.content: Nimbus decoder policy 2 replaces policy 1 and removes the legacy decoder.

entries.title: Nimbus synthetic record
entries.content: Nimbus decoder policy 1 keeps the legacy decoder.

rationale: The explicit replacement changes presence to absence.

entries.title: Opal synthetic record
entries.content: Opal result policy 1 treats an empty batch as failure.

entries.title: Opal synthetic record
entries.content: Opal result policy 2 replaces policy 1: an empty batch succeeds.

rationale: The same boundary case is explicitly redefined.

entries.title: Amber synthetic record
entries.content: Amber retries failed requests three times.

entries.title: Amber synthetic record

rationale: Count and interval jointly describe retries.

entries.title: Birch synthetic record

entries.title: Birch synthetic record

rationale: Different compatible requirements describe one release.

entries.title: Cobalt synthetic record
entries.content: Cobalt never caches errors.

entries.title: Cobalt synthetic record

rationale: Success and failure rules coexist.

entries.title: Dune synthetic record
entries.content: Dune health is at https://dune.example.invalid/health.

entries.title: Dune synthetic record

rationale: Endpoint location and response semantics complement each other.

entries.title: Elm synthetic record
entries.content: Elm measures duration in milliseconds.

entries.title: Elm synthetic record
entries.content: Elm rounds measured durations upward.

rationale: Units and rounding are independent aspects.

entries.title: Fable synthetic record
entries.content: Fable stops workers after 40 tasks.

entries.title: Fable synthetic record
entries.content: Fable drains in-flight tasks before stopping workers.

rationale: Limit and graceful stopping behavior coexist.

entries.title: Glint synthetic record

rationale: Primary ordering and tie breaking complement each other.

entries.title: Harbor synthetic record

rationale: Encoding and size constraints are compatible.

entries.title: Iris synthetic record

entries.title: Iris synthetic record

rationale: Different environments have compatible policies.

entries.title: Juniper synthetic record
entries.content: Juniper signs message headers.

entries.title: Juniper synthetic record

rationale: Signing and verification are parts of one process.

entries.title: Kite synthetic record
entries.content: Kite keeps a standby worker.

rationale: Capacity and failover behavior add different information.

entries.title: Lumen synthetic record
entries.content: Lumen calls validation a rehearsal.

entries.title: Lumen synthetic record
